boundary: This recovers the common diagnostic execution architecture, not a claim that every plugin is declarative or that all Toyota diagnostics can be implemented without plugin semantics. Specialized parsing, retries, session changes, security, and state machines remain executable behavior.

initial_read.mode_0: resolve selector 0xCA with GetCommFrmInfo, overwrite request byte indexes 1/2 with initial_read_did high/low, then CommCacheSndRcvExt
initial_read.mode_1: skip the initial selector-0xCA transaction and continue initialization
initial_read.other_modes: rejected by the plugin as C0040102
initial_read.response_extraction: bit_start/bit_end from +0x28/+0x2A select the initial value from the returned data

linked_monitor.other_modes: scan the generation-selected Data Monitor table for a row with flag 0x40 and matching initial_read_did/bit_start/bit_end, then copy that monitor row's u16 +0x34 key

panel_gate.helper: initialization helper ultimately uses CCommCachePlusP5::CheckSupportPanel for pattern/display entries

init_model.purpose: initialize one selected direct P5 Active Test from its type-68 record, optional initial RDBI value, linked Data Monitor, and presentation metadata
init_model.runtime_boundary: this profile reconstructs deterministic DB-to-command initialization; whether a test is offered still depends on role-0x06 DID/RID support state, and panel support may require live/cache state

control_flow.fallback_addressing: FunctionAddress only when bus ID == 0x22; otherwise normal GetCommFrmSndRcv

control_flow.primary_addressing: normal GetCommFrmSndRcv unless ECU detail flag == 1, then DifferentAddress

metadata_model.cli_join: tools/gts did enriches current monitor rows with signal_info from these exact tables

conversion_fields.pattern_display: monitor +0x42 key -> CDbPatDisp; value/string pairs -> display-info list at +0x74

metadata_model.transport: none in this plugin; constructs CCmdDatMonSignalInfo metadata from DDB records

response_model.record_count_source: received_length_minus_4, chunked until exhausted; receive byte 3 is skipped, not used as count
response_model.string_conversion: Windows MultiByteToWideChar code page 0 (CP_ACP) from zero-terminated <=16-byte chunk

role_catalog.scope: shared-runtime edges recovered from plugin imports; absence is not proof of no vehicle I/O

variable_layout.logical_model: same 1-based 6-byte [u32 relative offset][u16 length] table as V18 after namespace normalization
variable_layout.rule: when the base variable table is selected and variable_id > 0x2710, subtract 0x2710 before lookup

interpretation: Techstream's ordinary diagnostic command layer is a database-driven execution engine: the controller resolves an ECU/category plus DLL-role through CDbDllTable, dynamically loads a one-export Execute plugin, and the plugin selects master FuncCommFrame selectors. Shared CommandCommon code materializes CommSet/CommFrame send-mask-check bytes and sends them through KGP_CommFrameCtrl. Plugins remain necessary for control flow and specialized response handling, but the wire contracts are predominantly database material.

field_semantics.+0x00: send_parameter; copied to SendInt argument 4; common CAN SendProc does not consume it
field_semantics.+0x04: receive_timeout input; passed by pointer through CheckAndConvertRcvTimeOut before Receive

0x111.role: CommFrame -> send / receive-mask / receive-check variable references

execution_spine: Techstream UI -> CommandAPI typed request/response objects
plugin chooses one or more FuncCommFrame selector IDs and control-flow/fallback policy
DB 0x111 / CDbCommFrameTable + CDbVariableTable: CommFrame -> send/mask/check bytes

function_discovery.cache_miss: CDbEcuFuncInfoResRecords (0x11A) + CDbEcuFuncDetailsResRecords (0x11B), support-gated by CCmdCheckSupport, then SetFuncList
